parameters.name: EDITMODE
parameters.help: Traces may be either KILLED or REVERSED, or scanned for all ZEROs and then killed.  ZERO also zeros killed traces.

parameters.name: db_option
parameters.help: If you interactively created trace edit files, use this option to access one.

parameters.name: INC_MODE
parameters.help: The traces in the list can be either INCLUDED or EXCLUDED from subsequent processes.

choices.label: Kill/Reverse traces in select list
choices.help: kill or reverse all listed traces

choices.label: Kill/Reverse traces NOT in select list
choices.help: kill or reverse all traces NOT listed

parameters.name: KILLNAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a TRACE KILL parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: RVRSNAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a TRACE REVERSE parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: EDITKEY1
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the PRIMARY key for specifying traces to be edited.

parameters.name: EDITKEY2
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the SECONDARY key for specifying traces to be edited.

parameters.name: EDITKEY3
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the TERTIARY key for specifying traces to be edited.

parameters.name: EDIT_LST
parameters.help: Use MB1 to access the text editor and define the locations of the traces to be edited.
